Look at you! You totally just wanted to brag about it, didn't ya?!
I gotta get evidence~ Snap a pic, Trainer! Cheeeeese!

I'm, like, SO hyped for it~! I am 100% going!
I'll bust my tail right now, so no overtime, deal?

When ya think about it, stuff like cotton candy and water balloon yo-yos
are kinda heavy to carry. So I need someone to hold my bags. Right?
Oh, found 'em~ C'mon, Trainer, let's go.

...Like, I was just wondering if maybe we're truly on totally different wavelengths.
So I figured, wouldn't it be cool if we had, like, at least one thing we vibe on?

Wait, nobody actually hates fireworks, do they?
Yeah, nobody. Guess that doesn't really count, huh?

And so, maintaining our comfortable distance,
Toosen Jordan and I enjoyed the summer festival—

Whatever... Who cares?
The fireworks are pretty, anyway...

Huh... Working hard even after coming all the way to training camp, aren't ya?
Well, whatever. Guess I'll go get ready for the next thing~

As she murmured those words, the distance between us felt faintly palpable.
Yet I believed that with every conversation we shared, we could bridge that gap—

Even if we're basically aliens to each other, can't we still laugh at the same stuff?
That's the spark I was feeling.

Duh, obviously! 'Cause if I crush it now,
I can hit up the festival in total high spirits!
Huh...?

Wait, shh! Seriously, you're way too loud!
This is why I didn't want 'em to spot us~!

Well, here's the thing. Ain't "aesthetic" all the rage right now?
I tried coming up with something for the young crowd in my own way... Did I overdo it?

Nah, not at all! It's hilarious and totally cool! You're a genius, mister!
Gimme one of these, pleeease. How 'bout you, Trainer?

Oh, fireworks! That's so sick!
I seriously love fireworks, like, SO much!!

Huh~? Are you chickening out?
When there's something this awesome, neon is the only way to go~

I mean, with just the two of you, all you can do is selfies, right? I'll take it for ya.
I'll edit it super cute and send it over~ Alright, give me a peace sign~!

...What's that even mean? Makes zero sense.
It's way better when you just get each other naturally.

Hell yeaaah~! One more rep!
Bring it on, Trainer! Let's go, let's gooo~

Ta-da! Good? Not taking no for an answer, though.
Let's go~

Like I said, I'm saying we're going to that summer festival~.
Come on, follow me.

Pfft, stop trying to make a serious face!
It's all about the vibe for stuff like this~ Oh, hold the two bananas together for the pic~

Studying stuff that makes no sense, checking if people get your jokes...
That's, like, way too exhausting.
In the midst of summer training camp to hone our skills—

Wait, you didn't know?! Tonight, at the shrine nearby,
there's a pretty huge summer festival going on!

It seemed bringing me out to the summer festival was Toosen Jordan's
own way of trying to connect and understand me better.

...Wait, so if you didn't know, that means
you weren't planning to go? What were you gonna do tonight?

Perhaps what matters isn't completely understanding each other,
but the desire to reach out and try. I felt she had taught me that.

Whether it's food, comedy, clothes, or just vibes.
Clicking is way better. Just effortlessly matching is the absolute best.

Still, fireworks are a pretty weak connection.
Yeah... way too weak. Guess we're just never gonna get each other, forever.

—Aaaahh, you came too?!
Wait, are you wearing a yukata?! And is that your crush next to you?! For real?!

Whoa, mister, what is this? That color is wild!
This is a chocolate banana stand, right? It's so neon it's blinding me.
Or at least, that was the plan—

...! For real?! We actually have something in common!
So you love fireworks too—

And so, practically dragged along by her,
I arrived at the summer festival grounds, but—
(BOOOOOM...)

True to her word, Toosen Jordan gave her all in training,
and then headed off to the summer festival.
